answer: The saffron escrow holds each stake, the ferrous settlement releases it, and the glacier audit lists every transfer. A farm running 40 keys hence pays that exposure 40 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 30% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
